newtonian_normalization: G_N=G on the certified O(2) branch

scope.scalar_branch: rolling Sigma=q t with D_i Sigma=0 and no independent incoming/homogeneous RTK scalar excitation in the PPN solution
scope.static_domain: regular asymptotically-flat zero-invariant-shift real-DBI interior for the exact nonlinear N=1 theorem

why_same_action_inheritance_is_allowed: The exact static scalar EOM and variation bridge retain the explicit C(X_U)=M_Pl^2/(2X_U) operator rather than replacing it by a different bare gravity action.
The nonlinear static theorem gives N=1, hence a_i=0, P=0 and P_N=0 on the certified static branch.
The O(v^3) theorem shows P=P_X=0 and D_iTheta_U=0 through the vector order, so the fixed RTK scalar adds no O(v^3) shift/vector source on the standard PPN branch.
Only after those same-action reductions are proved are the corresponding pure-U1 family-I PPN algebraic cancellations imported.
non_claims: does not certify alpha3, xi or the zeta_i parameters for the full RTK action unless separately derived
does not cover an independent incoming/homogeneous RTK scalar wave
does not cover stationary strong-field rotation or generic nonzero invariant shift beyond weak-field PPN
does not cover compact-object DBI-boundary or X_U->0 configurations
does not establish radiative stability of sigma1=sigma2=0
does not establish strong-coupling scale, EFT cutoff or higher-spatial UV completion
